notes.ssh-remote-port-forward@1.0.3→1.0.4: Checked: 1.0.4 moved from ssh2 0.8 to ssh2 1.x, and every new install command is ssh2's optional native build — its install.js, then cpu-features' "node buildcheck.js > buildcheck.gypi && node-gyp rebuild" with the compiler and Python probes that go with it.
